title: Credits Music Patch
description: Properly implements the credits music that plays after jumping into the end portal!
body:
One of the things that disappointed me the most about revisiting old minecraft was that the beautiful 'Alpha' track by C418 was missing from the credits roll. This is due to a bug that causes it to never play. This mod simply fixes this issue.

This mod is client-side only meaning it will not run on a server but can be used when joining a server.

Report bugs to my discord at dopezombie420.
